content: Fix issue #88: the checkout page returns a 500 when the carrier has no rate for the destination.
Finding where the shipping quote is computed.

name: read_file
content:
27  def quote_shipping(order):
28      zone = Zone.for_address(order.address)
29      rate = carrier_client.get_rate(zone.code, order.weight)  # raises RateNotFound
30      return rate.amount
carrier_client.get_rate raises RateNotFound when the carrier has no rate for the zone, and nothing catches it, hence the 500. Turning it into a checkout error.
